title: Omega Live Copilot — Ingestion Sidecar Wire Contract (Phase 2)
description: Node↔Python message schema for the comment ingestion sidecar (PRD §7.1). PAPER CONTRACT ONLY. The capture method (抓包/OCR/manual) is a black box behind this wire format and is out of scope here — gated on Lei's real 中控 machine and explicit ToS risk acceptance. The core NEVER imports the sidecar; the contract is the message shape + transport + semantics below.

x-transports.jsonl: Sidecar appends one JSON object per line to storage.jsonl_raw_comments; core tails. Durable, replayable, at-least-once. PoC default.
x-transports.websocket: Loopback ws at ingestion.websocket.{host,port}; one JSON object per WS text frame. Best-effort, lower latency.
x-transports.manual: Operator UI emits identical `comment` frames (capture_source='manual'); the 副屏 degrade path (§7.1 failure降级) — guaranteed-shippable, no sidecar.

x-db-mapping.note: Validates against the Phase 1 schema (src/olc/db/schema.sql). Buckets are checked by tests/test_ingestion_contract.py.

requires_phase2_additive_migration.session_id: TEXT — groups comments to a session (sessions.session_id). comment_log has no session_id yet.
requires_phase2_additive_migration.capture_seq: INTEGER — per-session monotonic; ordering + loss estimation (§7.1⑤⑥).
requires_phase2_additive_migration.platform_msg_id: TEXT NULL — native id when available; primary dedup key.
requires_phase2_additive_migration.ingest_latency_ms: REAL — core-derived (ingest_at − captured_at); §7.1②. Not a message field.

x-db-mapping.migration_status: PROPOSED — NOT APPLIED. Phase 2 additive migration only; do not alter Phase 1 schema until Gate 1.

iso8601.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with millisecond precision and timezone offset.

platform.description: V1 = douyin only. Enum kept extensible for Phase 2.

comment.description: A single captured live-room comment. Sidecar fills capture-time fields ONLY; core fills processing fields (see x-db-mapping.core_populated_existing_column). Sidecar MUST NOT send core-populated fields.

capture_seq.description: Per-session monotonic +1 per comment. Seq gaps = lost messages (loss estimate §7.1⑥).

captured_at.description: When the sidecar captured it; core measures e2e latency from here (§7.1②③).

room_id.description: Own room only. Core MUST reject room_id ≠ configured own room (§12②/§2).

comment_text.description: Raw comment text. Core normalizes; sidecar does not.

username_hash.description: PREFERRED: sha256(lower(trim(username))+session_salt), 16 hex. Raw username MUST NOT cross IPC (§12③).

username_display.description: DISCOURAGED fallback only if source hashing infeasible. Core hashes immediately and drops raw; never persisted.

platform_msg_id.description: Native message id if the capture source exposes one. Primary dedup key.

resume.description: true if this is a reconnect continuation of an existing session_id.

stats.description: Sidecar's own counters for cross-check against core (dup/loss reconciliation).

heartbeat.description: Liveness. Cadence ≤ reconnect_max_seconds/2. Missing heartbeats > ingestion.reconnect_max_seconds (5s, §7.1④) => core marks link down.

seq.description: Echoes the highest capture_seq emitted so far (lets core detect silent loss).

gap.description: Sidecar declares an UNRECOVERABLE capture gap (§7.1④). Core marks a data gap in recap and does NOT assume backfill. This is the honest failure signal, not an error.
